state.document: An umpire's account of a clash about to be decided.
state.situation: Wartenberg Hussars II (hussar cavalry, fresh, steady) charges at the gallop Saxon Karabiniergarde (cuirassier cavalry in column, fresh, shaken) on open ground at Bříství, striking its flank.

situation.instructions: Judge the attacker's prospects in this clash from what the account says about formation, order, terrain, flanks, fatigue, morale and surprise.
criteria: hopeless: the attack cannot succeed; the defender holds every advantage
poor: the attacker is at a clear disadvantage
even: neither side has a clear advantage
favourable: the attacker has a clear advantage
decisive: the attacker holds every advantage; the defender cannot withstand it
